Due to unfixable technical issues, Workday Student is unable to manage the labs for CPSC 203. Therefore registration in the CPSC 203 lecture section is contingent on the availability for an appropriate lab section and space in the lab. Please see the list below for details on when and where labs are expected. The course staff will work with students to find a suitable lab time in the first week of classes. Students who cannot find a suitable lab time will unfortunately, need to be de-registered from the course
